name: Proyecto Ciudad Segura Colon Centro de Datos y Operaciones
developer: Ministerio de Seguridad Publica / Cable & Wireless Panama, S.A.
notes: Government cabinet act and state broadcaster report approval of the Ciudad Segura Colon contract, including the physical location of a Centro de Datos y Operaciones for an integrated surveillance platform with 435 smart cameras. This is a public-safety operations/data center, not a hyperscale or commercial colocation facility. No MW capacity found.

name: Tigo / Telecarrier IDC Divisa
notes: Uptime Institute country awards list IDC - DIVISA in Divisa, Herrera with Tier III design and constructed-facility certifications for Cable Onda. DCD reported the Divisa data center was inaugurated in May 2017 and later received Tier III constructed-facility certification; it is described as Telecarrier's third data center and an alternative colocation/disaster-recovery location outside Panama City. No MW capacity found.
